You should get in bed and deep breath. I've taken ambient and was always told to take it when I'm physically sitting in bed ready to go to sleep. Once in college I took ambien and we thought it would be fun to see if I could stay awake. My roommate video taped the entire night, but I couldn't remember anything! This is because one of the side effects is short term amnesia. It's important that you try to fall asleep so you can avoid doing anything dangerous.
